Input vector x (16 values)
[G_in, T, I1 ... I14]
G_in: mean irradiance (W/m2)
T: ambient temperature (degC)
I_k: current at probe V_k (A)
Training: MSE between standardised V_est and V_gmpp (global-MPP voltage of the simulated string); Adam 1e-3; early stopping on 2015-16
Use: V_est = initial command of P&O after a scan; the converter voltage loop applies V_cmd (D = PI(V_cmd - V_pv) + 1 - V_cmd/V_bus)
